Body.Content:
SQL MCP Server is now generally available, giving customers a secure, high-performance way to build agentic solutions with controlled access to production data. Built for SQL and compatible with PostgreSQL and Azure Cosmos DB, SQL MCP Server is a dynamic, self-hosted data-plane endpoint with caching, multiple data sources, REST, and GraphQL in one solution. Open source and free, it runs well in Azure, on-premises, or in any cloud. 

Learn more.
